科研实验楼 A 座。
科研实验楼 B 座。

启动区教学办公楼之一。

室内篮球馆、游泳池与健身空间。
Indoor courts, a swimming pool and fitness rooms.

The grandstand and sports rooms beside the track, under a folded-plate roof.
An apartment block tucked into the trees.
淡黄色的外墙衬着深圳的蓝天，推窗即可远眺。楼下有麦当劳。

Light grey and emerald green, above a public lawn ringed by trees.
朱红色的外观在青山绿树间格外醒目，四栋楼沿上园东缘排开。
Vermilion red against the green hills: four blocks along the eastern edge of the Upper Campus.
蓝白相间，与蓝天白云相呼应，位于上园正门内。

Everyday services for the Upper Campus: convenience store, bank and places to eat.
香港中文大学（深圳）附属幼儿园。
The kindergarten affiliated to the university.
上园西北坡地上的教职工公寓，五栋板楼依山势错落。
Five slab blocks of staff apartments stepping up the north-west slope of the Upper Campus.

琴房、排练厅与教学用房。
Practice rooms, rehearsal halls and classrooms.
